title: Validated form with submission handling
description: Typed React form wrapper with injected validation and submission, accessible error summaries, busy state, and duplicate-submit protection.

notes: Uses the consuming application's React and TSX pipeline. Contains a use client boundary. Inject client validation and an authenticated submission adapter.

configuration: Required initialValues, formLabel, validate(values), onSubmit(values), and render-prop children.
field(name, hintId) supplies IDs and accessibility attributes; setValue(name, value) keeps type conversion explicit.
Optional fieldLabels, submitLabel, submittingLabel, successMessage, submissionErrorMessage, and className.
limitations: Client validation is not server authorization or validation. The submission adapter must authenticate, authorize, validate, and persist independently.
Top-level fields only; no field arrays, nested path parser, schema library, automatic field rendering, or external service setup.
Values initialize once. Remount with a new React key when switching records. Reset returns to the original values.
Unexpected exception details are hidden; only explicitly returned field and form messages are shown. Pending network requests are not automatically canceled.
